games.name: Borderlands 4
notes: DirectX 12 only (Unreal Engine 5). Its .exe also links d3d11.dll, which is why an import scan alone reads DirectX 11.
Unreal Engine 5 with DLSS through NVIDIA Streamline; RenoDX DLSS 5 needs EnableHooks=1 there (AKENO sets it).

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
notes: With path tracing and Ray Reconstruction, OptiScaler DLSS 5 runs after the upscaler automatically (no pre-SR).

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
notes: Select DirectX 12 in the game's graphics settings. Story mode only: Red Dead Online is protected.

games.name: Control
notes: Start the DirectX 12 executable (Control_DX12.exe). The Skynizz presets were measured in Control.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
notes: DirectX 12 (next-gen) executable. The DirectX 11 executable has no DLSS; use the Feeder recipe there.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (DirectX 11)
notes: The DirectX 11 executable has no DLSS of its own, so DLSS5-Feeder supplies the inputs.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy
notes: Story Mode only. GTA Online uses BattlEye; do not go online with graphics mods installed.
FiveM is a separate entry: FiveM never loads mods from the GTA V folder.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
notes: Story Mode only. GTA Online uses BattlEye; do not go online with graphics mods installed.

games.name: FiveM Legacy
notes: FiveM renders GTA V Legacy through Direct3D 11 (Cfx rage-graphics-five) and loads graphics mods only from FiveM.app\plugins.
